west-africa.title: Wẹst Afrika
west-africa.description: Naijiria, Ghana, Côte d'Ivoire, Senegal, Mali, Burkina Faso, Guinea, Benin, Togo, Sierra Leone, Liberia an Niger — Lagos, Accra, Abidjan, Dakar, Abuja, Bamako, Ouagadougou an di Gulf of Guinea kost.

south-central-us.title: Saut Sẹntral US
south-central-us.description: Texas, Oklahoma, Arkansas, Louisiana, Kentucky, Tennessee, Mississippi an Alabama — Houston, Dallas, San Antonio, Austin, Oklahoma City, Tulsa, Little Rock, New Orleans, Louisville, Nashville, Memphis, Jackson an Birmingham.

west-polynesia.title: Samoa an Tonga
west-polynesia.description: Samoa, American Samoa, Tonga, Niue, Tokelau an Wallis an Futuna — Apia, Pago Pago, Nukuʻalofa, Alofi an Mata-Utu; Upolu, Savaiʻi, Tutuila an di aylands for Tonga.

mariana-islands.title: Guam an di Nọt Mariana Aylands
mariana-islands.description: Guam an di Nọt Mariana Aylands — Hagåtña, Tamuning, Dededo, Saipan, Tinian an Rota.

greenland.title: Greenland
greenland.description: Greenland — Nuuk, Sisimiut, Ilulissat, Qaqortoq an Tasiilaq; di big ays wey kova di land, di Ilulissat Icefjord an di fjords for saut.

bermuda.title: Bermuda
bermuda.description: Bermuda — Hamilton, St. George’s an di Royal Naval Dockyard, di ayland parishes an im pink-sand bich dem.

belarus.title: Belarus
belarus.description: Belarus — Minsk, Gomel, Mogilev, Vitebsk, Grodno an Brest; di Belovezhskaya Pushcha fọrest an di Polesia swamp dem.

channel-islands.title: Channel Aylands
channel-islands.description: Jersey, Guernsey, Alderney, Sark an Herm — St Helier, St Peter Port an Gorey.

faroe-islands.title: Faroe Aylands
faroe-islands.description: Di Faroe Aylands — Tórshavn, Klaksvík, Runavík an di eitin aylands, wit dia vilej, tọnel an sii klif dem.

svalbard.title: Svalbard
svalbard.description: Svalbard an Jan Mayen — Longyearbyen, Barentsburg an Ny-Ålesund; di glaciers an fjords for Spitsbergen.

malta.title: Malta
malta.description: Malta, Gozo an Comino — Valletta, Sliema, St Julian’s, Mdina, Victoria an di Three Cities.

madagascar-islands.title: Madagascar an di Indian Ocean Aylands
madagascar-islands.description: Madagascar, di Comoros, Mayotte, Réunion, Mauritius an di Seychelles — Antananarivo, Toamasina, Moroni, Mamoudzou, Saint-Denis, Port Louis an Victoria.

sudan.title: Sudan
sudan.description: Sudan — Khartoum, Omdurman, Port Sudan, Kassala, El Obeid an Nyala; wia di Blue Nile an White Nile mit, an di pyramids for Meroë.

cabo-verde.title: Cabo Verde
cabo-verde.description: Cabo Verde — Praia, Mindelo, Santa Maria an di ten aylands, from Santo Antão rich Brava.

sao-tome-principe.title: São Tomé an Príncipe
sao-tome-principe.description: São Tomé an Príncipe — São Tomé, Santo António an di rainfọrest an bich for di tu aylands.

saint-helena.title: Saint Helena, Ascension an Tristan da Cunha
saint-helena.description: Saint Helena, Ascension Ayland an Tristan da Cunha — Jamestown, Georgetown an Edinburgh of the Seven Seas.

bangladesh.title: Bangladesh
bangladesh.description: Bangladesh — Dhaka, Chittagong, Khulna, Rajshahi, Sylhet an Cox’s Bazar; di Sundarbans an di Ganges–Brahmaputra delta.

sri-lanka-maldives.title: Sri Lanka an di Maldives
sri-lanka-maldives.description: Sri Lanka an di Maldives — Colombo, Kandy, Galle, Jaffna, Trincomalee, Anuradhapura an Malé; di hil kọntri, Sigiriya an di atolls.

vietnam.title: Vietnam
vietnam.description: Vietnam — Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh City, Da Nang, Hai Phong, Hue, Hoi An an Can Tho; Ha Long Bay an di Mekong Delta.

philippines.title: Philippines
philippines.description: Di Philippines — Manila, Quezon City, Cebu, Davao, Iloilo, Baguio an Zamboanga; Luzon, di Visayas, Mindanao an Palawan.

indonesia.title: Indonesia an Timor-Leste
indonesia.description: Indonesia an Timor-Leste — Jakarta, Surabaya, Bandung, Medan, Yogyakarta, Denpasar, Makassar an Dili; Java, Sumatra, Bali, Borneo, Sulawesi an Papua.

malaysia-singapore-brunei.title: Malaysia, Singapore an Brunei
malaysia-singapore-brunei.description: Malaysia, Singapore an Brunei — Kuala Lumpur, Singapore, George Town, Johor Bahru, Malacca, Kota Kinabalu, Kuching an Bandar Seri Begawan.

myanmar.title: Myanmar
myanmar.description: Myanmar — Yangon, Mandalay, Naypyidaw, Bagan, Mawlamyine an Inle Lake; di Irrawaddy vali an di Shan hils.

cambodia-laos.title: Cambodia an Laos
cambodia-laos.description: Cambodia an Laos — Phnom Penh, Siem Reap an Angkor, Battambang, Vientiane, Luang Prabang an Pakse; di Mekong an di Tonlé Sap.

colombia.title: Colombia
colombia.description: Colombia — Bogotá, Medellín, Cali, Barranquilla, Cartagena an Bucaramanga; di Andes, di Caribbean kost an di Amazon.

venezuela.title: Venezuela
venezuela.description: Venezuela — Caracas, Maracaibo, Valencia, Barquisimeto, Mérida an Ciudad Bolívar; Angel Falls, di Orinoco an Isla Margarita.

peru.title: Peru
peru.description: Peru — Lima, Arequipa, Cusco, Trujillo, Iquitos an Puno; Machu Picchu, Lake Titicaca an di Sacred Valley.

ecuador.title: Ecuador
ecuador.description: Ecuador — Quito, Guayaquil, Cuenca, Manta an Baños; di Avenue of the Volcanoes, di Amazon an di Galápagos Aylands.

bolivia.title: Bolivia
bolivia.description: Bolivia — La Paz, El Alto, Santa Cruz, Cochabamba, Sucre an Potosí; Lake Titicaca an di Salar de Uyuni.

chile.title: Chile
chile.description: Chile — Santiago, Valparaíso, Concepción, Antofagasta, La Serena an Punta Arenas; di Atacama, di Lake District, Patagonia an Easter Ayland.

paraguay-uruguay.title: Paraguay an Uruguay
paraguay-uruguay.description: Paraguay an Uruguay — Asunción, Ciudad del Este, Encarnación, Montevideo, Punta del Este an Colonia del Sacramento.

guianas.title: Di Guianas
guianas.description: Guyana, Suriname an French Guiana — Georgetown, Paramaribo, Cayenne an Kourou; Kaieteur Falls an di rainfọrest for di Guiana Shield.

falklands.title: Falkland Aylands
falklands.description: Di Falkland Aylands — Stanley, Goose Green an di aylands for East an West Falkland.

australia.title: Australia
australia.description: Australia — Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Perth, Adelaide, Hobart, Darwin an Canberra; di Great Barrier Reef, Uluru an di Outback.

new-zealand.title: New Zealand
new-zealand.description: New Zealand — Auckland, Wellington, Christchurch, Hamilton, Dunedin an Queenstown; di Southern Alps, Fiordland an Rotorua.

british-columbia.title: British Columbia
british-columbia.description: British Columbia — Vancouver, Victoria, Kelowna, Kamloops, Prince George an Whistler; di Coast Mountains, Vancouver Ayland an di Okanagan.

canadian-prairies.title: Canadian Prairies
canadian-prairies.description: Alberta, Saskatchewan an Manitoba — Calgary, Edmonton, Winnipeg, Saskatoon, Regina an Banff; di Rockies, di prairies an Churchill for Hudson Bay.

ontario.title: Ontario
ontario.description: Ontario — Toronto, Ottawa, Mississauga, Hamilton, London, Kingston an Thunder Bay; Niagara Falls, di Great Lakes an Algonquin Park.

quebec.title: Quebec
quebec.description: Quebec — Montréal, Quebec City, Laval, Gatineau, Sherbrooke an Saguenay; di St. Lawrence, di Laurentians an di Gaspé Peninsula.

atlantic-canada.title: Atlantic Canada
atlantic-canada.description: New Brunswick, Nova Scotia, Prince Edward Island, an Newfoundland an Labrador — Halifax, St. John’s, Moncton, Saint John, Fredericton an Charlottetown; di Cabot Trail an di Bay of Fundy.

northern-canada.title: Nọtan Canada
northern-canada.description: Yukon, di Northwest Territories an Nunavut — Whitehorse, Yellowknife, Iqaluit, Dawson City an Inuvik; di Arctic Archipelago an di Mackenzie River.

hong-kong-macau.title: Hong Kong an Macau
hong-kong-macau.description: Hong Kong an Macau — Hong Kong Ayland, Kowloon, di New Territories, Lantau an di Macau Peninsula, Taipa an Coloane.
